articles.title: How are equity investments taxed in India? A guide to capital gains tax
articles.desc: In a bid to invigorate domestic and foreign mutual fund investments, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth recommendations for tax concessions. These proposals are designed to boost post-tax returns, particularly as market performance has been behind that of emerging counterparts. The current capital gains tax rates are seen as a hindrance, leading to demands for a review.

articles.title: Trump set for midterm test: What's in store for India, Iran, Ukraine after November 4?
articles.desc: US midterm election 2026: American voters' sentiments about rising prices could affect Trump's standing in trade discussions. Congressional control will determine the scrutiny over Trump's actions regarding Iran and Ukraine. India will, however, continue navigating uncertainties in trade relations regardless of the election results.

articles.title: Anthropic plans to sell $3.5 billion of shares to Japan investors in IPO, filing shows
articles.desc: The new shares issued to Japanese investors will go to raise working capital and fund operating expenses and capital expenditure, the filing said.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation ahead of December signing
articles.desc: In an effort to advance their free trade agreement, India and the European Union held pivotal discussions led by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal, who visited Brussels for dialogues with prominent EU officials. Central to the talks were customs cooperation and trade facilitation, deemed critical for the agreement's efficacy. Additionally, industry stakeholders from the diamond sector were engaged to harness opportunities within India's expanding market.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation, customs cooperation and market access in Brussels
articles.desc: India and the European Union engaged in discussions regarding the implementation of their Free Trade Agreement. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held meetings with various senior European Commission officials in Brussels, focusing on market access and customs procedures. The FTA is expected to eliminate tariffs on the majority of exports from both regions. Both parties are working towards the proposed signing and full ratification of the agreement.

HSBC to open Hong Kong AI Institute following Singapore launch
articles.desc: The AI unit will work with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as its anchor academic partner, Elhedery said, though he did not disclose headcount details.

articles.title: India factory growth slows in October, export orders jump, PMI shows
articles.desc: India's manufacturing growth slowed in October, with the HSBC Manufacturing PMI falling to 54.7 from 55.1 in September, as domestic demand and hiring weakened. However, export orders rose at their fastest pace in six months, providing some support to factory activity.

articles.title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge
articles.desc: Ternus, who took the reins from Tim Cook in September, has overseen the introduction of Apple's first foldable phone, smart home hub and Apple's first touch-screen laptops. All of those products began shipping during the company's current fiscal first quarter, amid what Cook had called a "100-year flood" of rising memory costs.
